messages:
maria_sales: Ok team — Arcadia Health POC kickoff next week. Need billing/project setup for POC account. They want: (1) $5k free credit, (2) hard spend cap at $600/month, (3) hosted API keys now, (4) Dedicated pool eval later (in ~2 weeks). Also need VPC gating info for Dedicated, and the procurement/invoice contact. cc @noah_sales_ops

sam_platform: Quick checklist: create billing org + project, apply promo credit, set spend cap. For Dedicated, that’s a separate reserved capacity flow — we can spin up a demo pool for evaluation; quotas are throughput-based. VPC gating requires an infra ticket + peering details. I can run the project bits.

josh_engineer: For keys: we can create a scoped hosted API key for the project and tag it "poc". Example header usage: `Authorization: Bearer pk_test_...`. For Dedicated eval we provision a temporary pool and add their CIDR to the whitelist. If they want VPC/private deploy later we’ll need their VPC/networks and KMS info.

emma_finance: We can apply the $5k credit to a project as an internal promo, but finance needs either a signed MSA or an email approval + account owner confirmation for bookkeeping. Spend cap: we can set a hard cap of $600 at the project level, but note hard caps will throttle API calls when reached. For invoicing we need procurement contact + PO# if they want an invoice in advance.

noah_sales_ops: I’ll collect PO/procurement. Maria — can you confirm the contact email and exact POC dates so finance can stamp the credit window?

infra-bot: infra-bot: Created project arcadia-poc-17640 (org: arcadia-health), API key pk_test_abc123 created and expires in 30d.

kevin_security: Quick FYI for the security questionnaire: for Dedicated/VPC we need to provide network flow diagrams and KMS/HSM details. I’ll prepare the SOC2 references and our data access controls. Also confirm whether Arcadia needs data residency — that can affect Private deployment timing.

maria_sales: Thanks. @sam_platform can you create the billing project and apply the credit now? @noah_sales_ops I’ll DM procurement contact and dates.

sam_platform: On it — created project id: arcadia-poc-17640, applied $5,000 credit, set monthly spend cap to $600, and attached API key pk_test_abc123 (tagged: poc). I added notes: POC window 2026-04-01 -> 2026-04-30. If they request Dedicated eval, open ticket #DP-1124 for demo pool provisioning.

josh_engineer: Suggestion: add route-level rate limits to avoid sudden bursts eating the cap. Example quick config:
```
route: /v1/generate
rate_limit: 20 rps
monthly_spend_cap_usd: 600
```
Also enable prefix KV cache on common prompts to save tokens.

emma_finance: Noted billing contact: procurement@arcadiahealth.com; finance will email the invoice template and confirmation of applied credit.

maria_sales: :thumbsup: Good progress. I’ll close this task for initial onboarding. Will reopen if they sign for Dedicated or request Private/VPC before the POC window ends.
